# gcore_cdn_presets (Data Source)

CDN presets are predefined sets of CDN resource or rule settings that can be applied to an object in a single request, letting you configure caching, delivery, and security options consistently.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cdn_presets" "example_cdn_presets" {

}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Preset ID.
- `name` (String) Preset name.
- `object_type` (String) Type of object the preset can be applied to.

Possible values:
- **CDNResource** - Preset is applied to a CDN resource.
- **Rule** - Preset is applied to a rule.
Available values: "CDNResource", "Rule".
- `preset_settings` (Map of String) CDN resource or rule settings that the preset applies to the target object, including the **options** object.

The available keys match the writable fields of the object type the preset targets (`object_type`).
Options included in the preset cannot be edited on the object while the preset is applied.
- `service` (String) Service the preset belongs to.
Available values: "cdn".
